landing.title: Welcome to Casa Perelos
landing.subtitle: Your rural accommodation in the heart of Galicia

hero.title: Discover Casa Perelos
hero.subtitle: An eighteenth-century manor lovingly restored so you can unwind among Galician nature, tradition and flavours.

intro.title: Authentic Galician hospitality
intro.body: Casa Perelos rises between oaks and meadows in the Ribeira Sacra. Every stone and beam tells the story of the family who still welcomes guests to experience a getaway with its own personality.

highlights.title: Suites full of character
highlights.body: Spacious rooms with exposed stone walls and natural fabrics designed for deep rest.

highlights.title: Farm-to-table flavours
highlights.body: Artisanal breakfasts with local produce and culinary proposals that celebrate Galician cuisine.

highlights.title: Nature and culture
highlights.body: Moments away from hiking trails, vineyards and charming villages across the Ribeira Sacra.
